title: 2026 Guideline for Adult Stroke Rehabilitation and Recovery: A Guideline From the American Heart Association and American Stroke Association

recommendations.text: AHA/ASA published this guideline online in Stroke on 27 August 2026 (PMID 42657476; DOI 10.1161/STR.0000000000000536). Per its PubMed abstract it replaces the 2016 AHA/ASA adult stroke rehabilitation guideline (PMID 27145936), and its key updates include new and revised recommendations on the assessment and treatment of medical comorbidities, fracture risk, fall prevention, technology-enabled rehabilitation, caregiver support, participation, and safe return to work and driving. The full recommendation tables (COR/LOE) could not be retrieved: there is no PMC deposit and the publisher and AHA/ASA sites were unreachable from the review environment (re-checked 2026-09-26). No recommendation-level extraction or clinical-currentness claim is made; the primary article is required to complete this record.
